tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Day is the CSS colour oldlace; night is midnightblue, the canvas colour many gallery examples already use. The dot grid is drawn on top of it.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, gallery tiles, the sketch panel and the search box.

tokens.name: paper-code
tokens.usage: Code blocks and the editor. Day is floralwhite.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The dot-grid pattern on paper, and decorative hairlines. Never text, never a control border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, paper-raised and paper-code (13.7:1 or better in both themes). Also the 2px outline and hard shadow on buttons, tiles and sketch panels. Day is midnightblue.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, hints under the editor. On paper, paper-raised and paper-code (at least 6.8:1).

tokens.name: tomato
tokens.usage: The brand colour, CSS tomato, the colour of the first sketch's circle. Fills only: primary buttons, the logo circle, highlights. Put ink text on it (5.0:1). Never use it as text on day paper (2.7:1).

tokens.name: on-tomato
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tomato fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links and inline emphasis. Day is firebrick (6.2:1 on paper), night is lightsalmon (7.5:1). Tomato's text-safe siblings.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: CSS gold. Highlights: the 'Try this' note, the active chip, the marker underline, the sun in the logo. Ink text on it (10.6:1).

tokens.name: hotpink
tokens.usage: CSS hotpink. Second accent for fills: stickers, the Sound and Ragas topics. Ink text on it (5.6:1).

tokens.name: turquoise
tokens.usage: CSS turquoise. Third accent for fills: the Motion and Interaction topics, the Play badge. Ink text on it (9.0:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: CSS teal, kept from the current site so returning visitors recognise it. Fills only, with white text (4.8:1); use for the secondary Run state.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill.

tokens.name: orchid
tokens.usage: Day darkorchid, night violet. Code keywords, and the focus ring in day theme (5.3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 3px solid focus ring with a 2px offset on every control. At least 5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings in code, such as "tomato". An alias of link.

tokens.name: code-number
tokens.usage: Numbers in code (5.5:1 day on paper-code, 10.7:1 night).

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Python keywords: import, def, for, if.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments in code, on paper-code (5.4:1 day, 7.5:1 night).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The home page headline only. 44px on phones.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Page titles on Home, Gallery and Play. 36px on phones.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles in the guide and reference.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Sub-sections, card titles, gallery tile titles.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: You write a short Python file, run it, and a window opens with your picture in it.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a page title. One per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Change "tomato" to "teal" and run it again.
styles.usage: All reading text in the guide, gallery notes and reference.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons and chips. Sentence case, never capitals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks and the Play editor.

styles.name: code-inline
styles.usage: Commands, file names and values inside a sentence.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; button padding top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tile caption padding; gap inside the sketch panel's toolbar.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gallery grid gap; space between a paragraph and a sketch panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding inside the hero and large panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space above section headings on Home and Gallery.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space between the big bands of the home page.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Distance between dots in the dot-grid paper. Line things up to it where you can.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, inputs, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, code blocks, gallery tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Sketch panels, the hero card, the Play editor frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and topic filters.

shadow.note: Shadows are hard and offset, like a sticker or a print slightly off register. No blur anywhere.

tokens.name: shadow-sticker
tokens.usage: Buttons, gallery tiles, sketch panels at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: The same element on hover or focus, together with a move of -3px, -3px.

tokens.name: shadow-pressed
tokens.usage: A button while it is pressed, together with a move of 3px, 3px.

tilt.note: Small rotations that make tiles feel placed by hand. Set them to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: tilt-left
tokens.usage: Every third gallery tile on hover; the 'Try this' note.

tokens.name: tilt-right
tokens.usage: Other gallery tiles on hover; stickers on the hero.

tokens.name: outline-width
tokens.usage: The ink outline on buttons, tiles, chips and sketch panels.
